target_customer: Small businesses in India collecting online payments from other businesses
problem: Small Indian businesses lacked a free way to collect online payments from business customers.
business_model: B2B payments network, possibly with purchase credit; monetisation not confirmed

founders.name: Gaurav Mishra
founders.background_notes: YC page lists no employers or education.

technical_complexity.rationale: Payment collection over existing Indian rails (UPI and bank transfers) is mostly integration, though compliance matters.

defensibility.rationale: Payment collection features were copyable by Razorpay, Cashfree and others; no network or data moat is shown.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Razorpay later built a B2B ecosystem around UPI; no source shows its direct effect on Cradle.

market_need_then: No dated 2020 evidence of demand was found; the YC description states small businesses lacked a free way to collect payments.

branding.domain_note: Used cradle.finance, which later redirected to an expired-domain page; YC lists cradlefinance.com, which did not resolve from this session.

brand_strength.rationale: No press, community or brand material found, and the .finance domain lapsed.

outcome_analysis: Cradle appears to be a tiny team of two. The sources opened give no funding, traction or shutdown news, and its cradle.finance domain redirects to an expired-domain listing, which suggests the original site lapsed. The YC page still shows it as active, so the outcome is unknown.
notes: Website: cradle.finance redirected (301) to an expiredreddomains listing, so the site appears dead; cradlefinance.com did not resolve in this session. Latka (an aggregator) says bootstrapped and a team of 2; not treated as a round. One profile names a second co-founder (Siddhartha Gorantla) with no company source, so not recorded. Outcome searches found no post-mortem or shutdown news. Competitor list left empty: no dated 2020 sources found.
